phases.description: One phrase of 40 native frames at 24 fps (1.67 s, inside the movement language's 1.6-2.0 s Ribbon Glide phrase): a small unhurried stroke in the first quarter, then a long glide with a slight float; arms quiet near the chest. The 81-frame take holds two phrases; review picks the cleaner one.
